## Editorial checklist

- [ ] Every sentence in the entry is supported by a cited source
- [ ] The status matches the strongest source (convicted / indicted / under investigation / allegation / public record)
- [ ] Each source has an archived copy (`archivedUrl`)
- [ ] The subject was asked for a response; any response received is included in full
- [ ] The subject acts in a public role (no private individuals)
- [ ] Both languages read correctly, or the missing one is intentional
- [ ] Reviewer is a different editor from the author
